judge_report.reasoning_summary: The chunking process has resulted in several overly long chunks, which can hinder retrieval quality by merging unrelated content and making it difficult to extract coherent information. Additionally, the separation score indicates that the current chunking may not effectively distinguish between relevant and irrelevant questions.
problems: Multiple chunks exceed the recommended length, with some reaching over 2600 characters, which can lead to loss of context and coherence.
There are no short chunks, but the absence of shorter chunks may indicate a lack of granularity in the chunking process.
The separation score suggests that the chunking is not effectively distinguishing between good and bad retrieval questions.
judge_report.feedback_for_chunker: Reduce the size of chunks to ensure they are coherent and focused on single topics or paragraphs. Aim for chunks that are more manageable in length, ideally under 1000 characters, to improve retrieval quality. Additionally, ensure that chunks do not cut off mid-thought and maintain clear paragraph boundaries.
